projection_method: Scale measured allocated GPU time for the first 3000 C updates, including checkpoint I/O, to 5000; add measured B and the brief D+E estimate of 2.3 GPU-hours. This is an estimate, not completed work.
checkpoint_save_interval_scope: Elapsed time between the update-3000 EMA center file modification and the intentional pause after the complete optimizer save; includes full-save I/O and pause detection.
mu_scope: Euclidean norm over all 128 stored mean coordinates per cell, then equal average over all 14400 layer-step-branch-head cells including exempt and unused entries. First logged update 1 versus update 3000; no token/prompt average at measurement time.
allocation_scope: Worker elapsed wall time multiplied by GPU count, including model loading, validation, saves, I/O waits and shutdown. The two training workers use two ranks each; screens use one GPU each.
